title: Filipino Pig Lechon
description: A classic Filipino dish known for its nutty, flaky, and aromatic flavors. This recipe features a sugar-free-friendly tomato sauce and a rich deglaze-fond.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, mix together lemon juice, garlic, black pepper, bay leaves, and star anise.
Add the pork belly to the marinade, making sure it is fully coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the pork from the marinade and place it in a large roasting pan.
Roast the pork in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Baste the pork with the pan juices every 10 minutes.
While the pork is roasting, heat the vinegar and tomato paste in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Bring the sauce to a boil and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and set aside.
After 30 minutes of roasting, remove the pork from the oven and increase the oven temperature to 425°F (220°C).
Brush the sugar-free tomato paste mixture all over the pork, making sure it is fully coated.
Return the pork to the oven and roast for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the skin is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Strain the pan juices and serve them with the roasted pork.
